title: Answer a note or add one from the page, in a compose box

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Design, proposed 2026-10-09: n opens a compose box for a new note on the issue, a answers the chosen note (foam's own verb). The box takes the bottom third of the notes pane, bordered and titled with what it answers. Enter is a newline, Ctrl-s writes through ops::note and reloads, Esc hides the box and keeps the draft until the page closes. This is the deliberate way in that commit 34d8e13 asked for: no write happens on a single unmodified key. The README line saying the screen cannot change anything goes.
